buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (I) ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Sl. No. Contents

1 1.1 Only Indigenous manufacturers are eligible to quote. The tenderer shall submit ISO certificate / the certificate from any Govt. / Govt. authorized agency to show that the bidder is a manufacturer of HYDRAULIC JACKS. 1.2 The intending indigenous tenderer shall submit copies of work order/agreement and commissio ning/completion certificate and Excise/GST invoice in support of supply of 100 Ton and ab ove capacity Hydraulic jack along with pump . Successfully completed by them to any of the following organization during last seven years, from bid invitation date. · Govt. Organization · PSU · Public Limited Company · Joint venture Company where at least one partner is Govt. Organization or PSU. 1.3 AS documentary evidences, the bidder shall furnish self-attested copies of purchase orders/ rate contract and corresponding. a) Copy of work order/P.O. b) Corresponding Delivery Challan and invoice OR completion certificate OR performance certificate issued by purchaser as on bid submission date the above purchase orde r is a Regular Order and not a trial order. 1.4 In case the supply is effected indirectly then the bidder has to submit relevant documents to es tablish that the end user of the item supplied against the purchase order is amongst the four ty pe of organization mentioned above. 2 2.1 In support of financial capability, tenderer shall submit audited annual Balance sheet/ profit loss statement for any consecutive three of last four years from bid invitation date. The average annual turnover of the firm for any consecutive three of last four years shall be equal to or more than Rs.4.50 Lakh 2.2 Tenderers who have started business since last one years and turn over value is having increas ing trend then average of the two turnover values shall be equal to or more than Rs.4.50 Lakh or if turnover value is having decreasing trend then lower of the two turnover values shall be eq ual to or more than Rs.4.50 Lakh. 2.3 Tenderers who have started business since last one year only, 50% of the turnover value shall be equal to or more than Rs.4.50 Lakh. 3 3.0 The bidder is required to submit self-attested photo copies of documents in support of their elig ibility criteria and experience along with the techno-commercial bid. In addition, bidders shall su bmit an Undertaking, that the documents submitted by them are genuine. 4 4.0 SAIL/BSL reserves the right to call for original documents for verification at any time during tend ering, evaluation and / or the execution of the contract. In case of any documents/information s ubmitted by bidder(s) found to be false or containing any misrepresentation of having any fraud ulent declaration in it, then in such eventuality, legal action (including cancellation of contract, banning of business dealing, damages, criminal proceedings etc.) as deemed fit may be initiate by BSL against the bidder. Common Technical Requirements (II) 1 The hydraulic jack shall be suitable for heavy-duty industrial maint enance applications.

2 The complete system shall be suitable for 700 Bar working pres sure. 3 The two-speed hand pump shall be suitable for operation of the res pective jack and shall provide rapid approach as well as high-pr essure lifting. 4 Hydraulic hose, pressure gauge, adaptor and quick release coupler shall be compatible with the jack and rated for 700 Bar minim um working pressure. 5 The jack shall be supplied with all necessary accessories required f or safe and satisfactory operation. 6 The supplier shall clearly indicate the Make, Model, Rated capacity ,stroke, Maximum working pressure,Pump Type, Oil requiremen t and seal kit details of the supplied hydraulic jacks. 7 The supplier should clearly indicate complete replacement pump a ssembly ,suitable for the respective Hydraulic Jack including all necessary valves, seals, O-rings and accessories required for ins tallation ans satisfactory operation.The supplier shall confirm co mpatibility with the offered Jack and provide pump model/part n umber and rated pressure. 8 The supplier should clearly indicate complete set per Hydraulic Jac k including all seals and sealing elements required for complete overhauling /replacement of seals. The supplier shall provide th e seal kit suitable for the exact model and specifications of the supplied Hydraulic jack. 9 Every Pump/Jack system supplied shall have a suitable pressure rel ief/overload protection arrangement to prevent operation beyon d rated pressure. 10 All seals and sealing elements shall be suitable for the specifie d pressure and recommended hydraulic oil. 11 The supplier shall submit the manufacturer's catalogue/Dat asheet along with the offer. 12 The supplier shall mention the make, model, country of ori gin, weight, oil capacity and seal kit details in the technical offer.

13 Each jack shall be tested at the manufacturer’s recommended test pressure/load and Test certificate confirming satisfact ory load /pressure to be supplied with every jack.Each jack shall be supplied with a suitable test certificate. 14 Any deviation from the above specification shall be clearly indi cated by the bidder. (III)SPECIAL TERMS& CONDITION: 1) FIRM MUST FURNISH GUARANTY/ WARANTY FOR 12 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF COMMISSIONING OR 18 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY WHICHEVER IS EARLIER. 2) TEST CERTIFICATE OF NO LOAD & FULL LOAD TO BE ENCLOSED DURING SUPPLY FROM GOVERNME NT APPROVED LAB. 3) DELIVERY WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM THE ISSUE OF P.O. COMMON REQUIREMENTS Each hydraulic jack shall be supplied as a complete set with: (i) Two-speed hand pump (ii) 2.0 m long Thermo plastic High Pressure hose pipe. (iii) Pressure gauge with suitable adapter (iv) Quick-release coupling ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS (i)FOR HYDRAULIC JACK OF 100 Ton: 1 No. additional quick-release coupler and spare seal kit for eac h jack and pump. (ii) FOR HYDRAULIC JACK OF 200 Ton: 1 No. spare gauge adapter. (iii) FOR HYDRAULIC JACK OF 50 Ton: 1 No. additional quick-release coupler and spare seal kit for eac h jack and pump. (iv) FOR HYDRAULIC JACK OF 20 Ton: 1 No. spare gauge adapter. RISK PURCHASE CLAUSE: (IV) Subject to the Terms and Conditions of the GEM contract ,if the Seller/ Supplier neglects or fails to pe rform the contract by the time or times agreed upon, for any reason other than Force Majeure, the B uyer/Purchaser after having come to know of such negligence or non-performance, after giving 15 da ys notice to the Seller/Supplier or any such extended period that the Seller/Supplier and Buyer/Purch aser may mutually agree, to the Seller/Supplier to rectify , shall take such action as it considers fit in cluding but not limited to taking risk purchase for supply of the material, mitigating any losses , at th e risk and cost of the Seller as far as the undelivered quantity in that Delivery Period is concerned. T he Right of the Buyer for Risk Purchaser Action is in addition to the Right of Buyer to terminate the C ontract due to the fault of the Seller/Supplier. The price differential in case of higher costs to SAIL, BSL ,KIOM/MIOM if any, shall have to be borne b y the defaulting Seller/Supplier. SAIL ,BSL ,KIOM/MIOM reserves the right to recover the price differential from pending bills of the supplier in BSL or other units of SAI L. Moreover the defaulting Seller/Supplier have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to suppl y.

(V) Guideline on Verification of Credentials submitted by Bid ders during Tender Evaluation: i) SAIL reserves the right to verify any supporting document(s) submitted by a participating tenderer / bidder from its source (document issuing authority). ii) In the interest of expeditious completion of verification, a participating tenderer /bidder shall provi de a list of each supporting document on its letter-head as per "Annexure-S", along with the contact details (postal address, email address, landline / mobile number) of the issuing authority of each sup porting document for verification. iii) Non-verification of any supporting document or information, at the sole discretion of SAIL, does no t absolve the tenderer / bidder of its absolute responsibility to provide only genuine document(s) in s upport of eligibility conditions. iv) In case a supporting document or information is found to be fake/forged/tampered/ non-genuine a t any stage during tendering process & even after placement of Purchase Order / Work Order, the ten derer/bidder is liable for punitive actions as per extant guidelines of SAIL.
